Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Yichi, the maker behind SurgePix.

SurgePix puts the whole job in one place — no juggling a dozen tools. Its built-in design agent can even search the live web and design straight from what it finds.

It started with a simple frustration: every AI image tool I tried was great at generating something new, but the moment I wanted to tweak a color, swap a headline, or keep things on-brand across a whole set of visuals, I was stuck starting over. [...] So we built SurgePix around three ideas:

 Edit, don't regenerate: brush over any area to repaint it, split a flat image into editable layers, or pull the text off an image to retype it
 Upload your brand assets once, and every output stays on-brand
 For developers: SurgePix ships as open-source agent skills, so Claude Code, Cursor, or any AI agent can generate and edit visuals for you — right from your terminal, no browser needed

We're still early and shipping fast. Would love to hear what you think, and what you'd want SurgePix to do next.
